主要内容: BLONDER TONGUE LABORATORIES INC held its 2021 Annual Meeting of Stockholders on May 26, 2021, with a record date of April 15, 2021, and 11,960,505 shares of common stock outstanding. Shareholders voted on the election of directors and the ratification of the independent registered public accounting firm. Three nominees were elected as Class II directors, each serving a three-year term expiring at the 2024 annual meeting. Stockholders approved a proposal to ratify the appointment of Marcum LLP, certified public accountants, as the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2021.
